Installs over 0.1.6, 0.1.7 and 0.1.8 and keeps your saved designs. If you still have 0.1.5 or earlier, uninstall it first (share any project specification you want to keep, because uninstalling deletes saved projects).

**Change colour and size inside AR**

- Tap **Colour** in full-size AR to switch the laminate from swatches, by group (Wood, Marble, High gloss and more). Designs with a feature panel or detail laminate let you switch each one.
- Tap **Size** to change width, height and depth while the furniture stays where you placed it.
- Changes made from the editor are kept in the design when you leave AR.

**15 new designs: TV units, wall panels, partitions and designer wardrobes**

- TV units: Marble arch TV unit, Halo TV wall, Sculpted wave TV wall and Glow frame TV wall.
- Wall panels: Marble & slat wall, Nero feature wall, Fluted stone wall, Gold inlay marble wall, Slatted niche wall and Arch niche shelving.
- Partitions: Arch mirror partition, Lattice archway and Niche archway.
- Wardrobes: Arc dressing wardrobe and Gloss window wardrobe.
- Each design resizes and works in full-size AR, with LED strips, bronze mirrors, gold trims and smooth arches and curves.
- Choose a feature panel laminate (marble, stone, gloss) and a detail laminate (slats, shelves) as well as the main laminate. The specification lists every laminate.
